label: Hero Section
help_text: Full-width hero section with eyebrow label, headline, subheadline, body copy, and primary CTA. Supports background image or solid color.

fields.name: eyebrow_text
fields.label: Eyebrow / Label Text
fields.help_text: Small uppercase label above the headline (e.g. 'LIVE | New In-Person Marketing Workshop').
fields.default: LIVE | New In-Person Marketing Workshop | Las Vegas, NV

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Main Headline (H1)
fields.help_text: Primary headline. Keep to 6–10 words for maximum impact.
fields.default: The Workshop That Actually Grows Your Business

fields.name: subheadline
fields.label: Sub-Headline (H2)
fields.default: Two days. Real frameworks. Real results. Come learn how the top 1% acquire customers.

fields.name: body_copy
fields.label: Body Copy
fields.default: Join 300+ founders, operators, and marketers for an intensive hands-on workshop. Walk away with a 90-day marketing playbook you can execute immediately.

fields.name: cta_subtext
fields.label: CTA Sub-text
fields.help_text: Small italic note below the CTA (e.g. 'Limited seats. No refunds.').
fields.default: Limited seats available. Tickets are non-refundable.

fields.name: background_image
fields.label: Background Image
fields.help_text: Optional full-bleed background image. Leave empty to use background color instead.

fields.name: background_color
fields.label: Background Color
fields.help_text: Used when no background image is set.
